changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE plan_revocations ADD COLUMN trigger varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ARREARS', ALTER COLUMN instalment_sequence DROP NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN instalment_due_date DROP NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_plan_revocations_trigger CHECK (trigger IN ('ARREARS', 'INACTIVITY', 'FINISH_BY')), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_plan_revocations_instalment CHECK ((trigger = 'ARREARS') = (instalment_sequence IS NOT NULL) AND (trigger = 'ARREARS') = (instalment_due_date IS NOT NULL)); COMMENT ON COLUMN plan_revocations.trigger IS 'Why notice was given: ARREARS (instalment plan), INACTIVITY or FINISH_BY (flexible plan). Only a verified payment ends an INACTIVITY notice; only finishing the plan ends a FINISH_BY one.';
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM plan_revocations WHERE trigger <> 'ARREARS'; ALTER TABLE plan_revocations DROP CONSTRAINT chk_plan_revocations_instalment, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_plan_revocations_trigger, ALTER COLUMN instalment_due_date SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN instalment_sequence SET NOT NULL, DROP COLUMN trigger;
